# Carson Poore Consulting

> A growth consultancy in Indianapolis, Indiana with four practices (marketing, technical, strategy, and coaching) for local small businesses, founders, and nonprofits. Prices are published on the site: monthly retainers at $1,200, $2,400, or $4,800, a $3,000 one-time strategy engagement (half credited toward a retainer if the client continues), and a reduced nonprofit rate. Eight clients at a time across all engagements, a three-month minimum then month to month, and clients keep everything (site, Google Business Profile, ad accounts, data) if they leave. Serves Indianapolis and central Indiana locally; technical and coaching work nationwide. Contact: carson@carsonpoore.com.

## Practices

- [Marketing](https://carsonpoore.com/services/marketing): Brand, campaigns, content, and email measured in calls, customers, and booked work.
- [Technical](https://carsonpoore.com/services/technical): AI agents and automation, websites and web apps, GoHighLevel and CRM, Google Ads, and GA4, priced for small businesses.
- [Strategy & planning](https://carsonpoore.com/services/strategy): A $3,000 one-time engagement covering positioning, ideal customer, offer, and a 90-day plan the client keeps; $1,500 is credited toward a retainer if the client continues.
- [Coaching & growth](https://carsonpoore.com/services/coaching): Fractional CMO and marketing advisory at $1,200 to $4,800 a month, with the plan and the hands on one team.

## Services

- [Branding](https://carsonpoore.com/services/branding): Logo and identity from $750; full brand system (identity, brand voice, guidelines) from $2,000. Positioning comes from the strategy engagement.
- [Content marketing](https://carsonpoore.com/services/content-marketing): Articles that answer customer questions, email newsletters, and guides, run inside the monthly retainers.
- [Social media](https://carsonpoore.com/services/social-media): Planning, posting, short-form video, and replies on the platforms customers use, run inside the monthly retainers.
- [Video & photo](https://carsonpoore.com/services/video-photo): Intro video from $1,200, short-form video pack (6 vertical videos) from $750, half-day photo shoot from $500, shot on location in central Indiana.
- [SEO & AI search](https://carsonpoore.com/services/seo): Technical foundations, answer-first pages, structured data, and getting found in Google and AI answers; runs inside the monthly retainers.
- [Local SEO](https://carsonpoore.com/services/local-seo): Google Business Profile, reviews, and local search visibility in Indianapolis and central Indiana.
- [Google Ads management](https://carsonpoore.com/services/google-ads): Search ads with tracking set up first; the client owns the account and the leads.
- [Web design & development](https://carsonpoore.com/services/websites): Fast small-business websites and web apps the client fully owns.
- [AI agents & automation](https://carsonpoore.com/services/ai-automation): Practical automation for small businesses, with a human approving what goes out.
- [GoHighLevel & CRM](https://carsonpoore.com/services/crm-gohighlevel): GoHighLevel setup, migration, pipelines, and follow-up automation.
- [GA4 & analytics](https://carsonpoore.com/services/analytics): GA4 cleanup, conversion and call tracking, and monthly reports a person can read.
- [Google Ad Grants](https://carsonpoore.com/services/google-ad-grants): Management of Google's $10,000/month in-kind search ads program for eligible nonprofits.

## Who we help

- [Local businesses](https://carsonpoore.com/for/local-businesses): Trades, home services, restaurants, retail, and salons in central Indiana.
- [Founders & startups](https://carsonpoore.com/for/founders): Strategy engagement first, then fractional CMO support and technical builds.
- [Nonprofits](https://carsonpoore.com/for/nonprofits): Ad Grants, donor CRM and email, storytelling, and board-ready reporting at a reduced rate.

## Pricing and method

- [You keep everything](https://carsonpoore.com/ownership): What clients own (domain, site, Google profile, ad accounts, data) and how leaving works.
- [Pricing](https://carsonpoore.com/investment): All published prices, terms, and what every retainer includes.
- [Project pricing](https://carsonpoore.com/investment#projects): Starting prices for one-time projects: starter website from $900, business site from $2,500, simple web tool from $6,000 (larger custom web apps quoted per project), logo and identity from $750, full brand system from $2,000, intro video from $1,200, short-form video pack from $750, half-day photo shoot from $500.
- [The method](https://carsonpoore.com/method): Five steps: Conviction, Your people, A sharp offer, The experience, Word of mouth.
- [About](https://carsonpoore.com/about): Founder Carson Poore, mission, vision, and values.

## Free tools (no email required)

- [The Five-Step Check-Up](https://carsonpoore.com/tools/checkup): 10-question self-assessment scored on the five method steps.
- [Can Indianapolis Find You?](https://carsonpoore.com/tools/local-visibility): 18-item local visibility self-audit with a letter grade.
- [AI Opportunity Finder](https://carsonpoore.com/tools/ai-opportunity-finder): Ranks your repetitive tasks by how automatable they are.
- [What Should Marketing Cost?](https://carsonpoore.com/tools/marketing-budget): Budget calculator based on revenue and stage.
- [90-Day Plan Starter](https://carsonpoore.com/tools/90-day-plan): Builds a printable one-page 90-day marketing plan.
